original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚总统助理被指威胁分居妻子，警告其勿回家
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据SaharaReporters报道，尼日利亚总统博拉·蒂努布的学生事务高级特别助理Sunday Adedayo Asefon被指威胁其分居妻子Damilola Tunmise Asefon，警告她不要回家。此前，其妻向埃基蒂州警察局长提交请愿书，指控Asefon暴力殴打他们10岁的女儿，致其耳部和头部出血。报道称，Asefon的家人还举行会议并涉嫌威胁要对付其妻，并指责她泄露请愿书以损害丈夫的政治前途。上述指控均来自接近家庭的单一来源，尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚总统蒂努布的高级特别助理Sunday Asefon被指威胁其分居妻子，警告她不要回家
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he has threatened his estranged wife, Damilola Tunmise Asefon, over a police petition accusing him of brutally assaulting their 10-year-old daughter

key_facts.fact: 其妻向埃基蒂州警察局长提交请愿书，指控Asefon殴打10岁女儿致耳部和头部出血
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the petition she submitted to the Ekiti State Commissioner of Police, seeking an investigation and prosecution over the alleged assault that reportedly left their 10-year-old daughter... bleeding from her ears and head

key_facts.fact: 据称Asefon家人举行会议并威胁要对付其妻
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: members of Asefon's family have been holding meetings over the petition and allegedly threatening to deal with his estranged wife wherever they see her

key_facts.fact: Asefon家人被指指责其妻泄露请愿书以损害丈夫政治前途
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Asefon's family members have been accusing the estranged wife of deliberately publicising the allegations to damage her husband's political career

uncertainties: 殴打女儿的指控尚未获独立证实
